entities.summary: Joan Baptista Pujol i Riu was a Catalan pianist and pedagogue. He studied at the Paris Conservatory with Napoleón-Henri Reber. He was the teacher of Enrique Granados, Ricardo Viñes, and Joaquim Malats (ca) (1872-1912).
